sketchMechanisms: The Maybe monad's >>= operator silently propagates Nothing through a chain of computations, so if any step yields Nothing, the entire result is Nothing without any explicit check.
A weak reference automatically becomes nil when the object it references is deallocated — the runtime silently erases the connection without notifying the holder.
method_missing is called when an object receives a message it does not understand — it can respond to anything, even calls that were never defined.
